$comment: MEMBERS — businesses whose owner has PAID and whose preview page therefore renders Live. Derived from mva's previews/claims-snapshot.json, a census of activate's D1. Written by scripts/sync-previews-manifest.mjs; never by hand.
$two_classes: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-20. `tiers` maps slug -> pricing.json tier id. 'agent-ready' is the $500 SELF-SERVE tier: paid and published, with NO ownership attestation. 'agent-ready-business' and 'agent-ready-premium' are ATTESTED: ownership was verified during onboarding. llms.txt and llms-full.txt name the two groups separately, because one heading asserting domain verification over both would be a false attestation on the surface agents read first. An absent entry reads as SELF-SERVE — the weaker claim, which is the only safe default.
$why_not_claimed_json: mva's previews/claimed.json is hand-written and is now the ATTESTED store only — self-serve claims never enter it, and its build-time reconciliation is scoped to the ONE tranche being built. The snapshot is whole-corpus and covers both publish paths.
$absent_is_not_empty: A missing or unreadable file throws rather than resolving to zero members — dropping a paid member silently is the failure this file exists to prevent.
